name: mcp-ssh-tool
description:
SSH automation MCP server that enables Claude and ChatGPT to execute
commands, manage files, install packages, and control services on
remote servers over SSH — supporting password, key, and agent authentication.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level for the server (error, warn, info, debug).

KNOWN_HOSTS_PATH.description: Custom path to the known_hosts file for host key verification.

SSH_DEFAULT_KEY_DIR.description: Custom directory to search for SSH keys.

STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING.description: Enable strict host key checking. Set to 'true' and optionally provide KNOWN_HOSTS_PATH to enforce verification.
